app.name: Unmyst
app.description: Finally see through all your subscriptions and memberships in one place. Unmyst is a subscription manager that helps you track, manage, and cancel your subscriptions with ease.

hero.line1: A yearly plan is not cheaper.
hero.body: €131.88 once a year and €10.99 every month cost the same. One of them you notice. unmyst puts every subscription on a single scale — what it costs you per month — so the quiet ones stop hiding behind their billing cycle.

one.title: Yearly plans divided by twelve
one.body: Every subscription gets a levelled monthly figure, so a €131.88 annual charge sits next to a €23.90 monthly one and the comparison is honest. The real charge and its cycle stay visible on the same row.

two.title: Billed and averaged, kept apart
two.body: Two figures, never blended. Actually billed is what your bank sees on the day it happens, spikes included. Averaged out spreads everything evenly — nothing is billed that way; it exists so you can budget one number.

three.title: Shared plans count your half
three.body: Record a split and your share becomes the primary number everywhere, with the full charge underneath. The monthly figure then reflects what actually leaves your account.

ledger.title: One list, sorted by what happens next
ledger.body: Renewals group into this week, later this month, and further out — each with the amount actually leaving your account. Every row carries the real charge, the cycle, and the levelled monthly figure side by side, so nothing is comparable-looking by accident.

data.title: Nothing leaves your machine
data.body: unmyst never connects to your bank. You type in what you pay; it does the arithmetic. No account, no third-party analytics, no card data — and an export you can take with you.

limits.bank: Connect to your bank or read transactions — you enter what you pay.
limits.cancel: Cancel anything for you. It tells you what to cancel; the clicking is yours.
limits.guess: Guess at prices. An unedited plan keeps the last figure you gave it.
limits.oneOff: Track one-off purchases. If it doesn't recur, it doesn't belong here.

quote.text: I thought I paid for four things. It was sixteen, and three of them were the same registrar.

cta.title: Find out what you actually pay
cta.body: It takes about ten minutes to enter a year of subscriptions. Most people are wrong by a factor of two.
